interface.title: E-QuakeVis (Database Gempa)
interface.stage_of_work: exploration, analysis and reporting of an earthquake catalog, including hazard review and producing a publication map
interface.what_it_is_for: Filter the Indonesian BMKG/USGS earthquake catalog by time, magnitude, depth, region, coastline distance and map box, look at the epicenters on a fault/trench map and as hypocenters against Slab2 slab surfaces, review precomputed PSHA hazard maps and curves, and export the event table and a print-ready map sheet.

data.note: The bundled gempa_working.sqlite holds 1,322 events (28 Apr – 26 Jul 2026). The precomputed PSHA run is 'ntt_revisi1_run1 · v2024.0.0 · 620 situs' (620 sites, Sumba/NTT area). Uploaded test files gempa_sample_mixed_invalid.csv and gempa_sample_missing_columns.csv were used only to check import validation and were not added to the database. Most basemap tiles loaded (Esri topo, OpenTopoMap), but the 'Humanitarian' basemap stayed grey (screens/029.webp).

tree.general: isolate an earthquake set of interest, interpret its tectonic setting and hazard, and report it
tree.specific: filter the Indonesia catalog, read the hypocenters against Slab2, review precomputed PSHA, and export the table and an A4 publication map; building a new PSHA model (Bangun Model PSHA) is also a purpose of the tool but was blocked on this server (no GEM logic tree, no OpenQuake) and is not in this tree
